title: Two Former Chinese Military Personnel Arrested in South Korea for Espionage
description:
Two ex-Chinese military servicemembers were arrested in South Korea on espionage charges. They are accused of intercepting communications between fighter jets and ground control, and collecting sensitive information regarding U.S. armaments. One suspect, in his 60s, allegedly set up an interception device near a U.S.-South Korean air base, while the other, in his 40s, is accused of gathering information from a South Korean woman employed at the U.S. military headquarters. The police are investigating whether the intercepted communications were relayed to Chinese authorities. Both men previously served in the Chinese military and face charges for violating laws on aiding the enemy and protecting military installations. The arrests coincide with the commencement of large-scale U.S.-South Korean military exercises.

Key Points:
• Two former Chinese military personnel arrested for espionage in South Korea.
• Suspects intercepted communications between fighter jets and ground control since 2024.
• Investigation ongoing to determine if intercepted data was shared with Chinese authorities.
